text:
alex: FYI saw a big tail-latency spike after the kernel switch at 03:22 — Mixtral-8B MQA with paged KV. p95 up ~1.3x, p99 1.8x. Flame shows lots of memcpy + kernel fallback churn.
maria: Can you paste the profile / kernel name and batching config?
alex: Here's the quick run-summary from the local flame:```model: mixtral-8b
mode: MQA
kv_layout: paged
num_kv_heads: 32
kv_dim_per_head: 64
kernel_selected: gqa_fallback_v2
batching: qbatch=8 continuous
p50/p95/p99: 45ms/120ms/210ms
cpu memcpy: 18%
kernel_launch: 32%
page_faults: 0
```ben: Looks like headstride alignment is wrong — 32 * 64 = 2048 which doesn't pack nicely for our 128/256 head kernels. That can force extra memcopies and kernel shims.
zhang: Also seeing paged-KV fragmentation: allocator splitting small requests for variable seq lengths, leaves many partially-filled slabs -> more memcpy & slower kernel choose.
sasha: Quick mitigation that helped in local perf: enable kv_slab_coalesce + pad headstride to 256, and drop qbatch to 4 for latency SLOs. Local p99 dropped from 210ms -> ~160ms. Quality change negligible for the quick checks.
maria: Any experiments trimming num_key_value_heads (32->16) or changing kv_dim?
alex: 16 heads gave ~30% throughput lift but some degradation on instruction-following evals. Need to run full eval set before considering. Proposed rollout: canary 5% dedicated capacity with synthetic perf run (seq=2048 mixed batch), plus token-level regression checks.
sasha: Also propose a kernel-selection rule tweak: prefer 'packed_head_v3' when (num_kv_heads % 8 == 0) and (kv_dim_per_head % 32 == 0). Only fallback to gqa_fallback_v2 if estimated memcpy > threshold and queue depth above X. That avoids unnecessary kernel swaps mid-request.
ben: I'll push a conservative runtime patch: add kv_padding option, a headstride pad path, and counters for kernel-switch count + memcpy ratio. Will add a perf histogram for 'kernel_latency_by_headstride'.
perf-bot: perf-bot: experiment created: exp/kv-coalesce-1712345678, queued runs on dedicated infra.
alex: I'll open a task and add dashboards: per-model KV-frag %, memcpy ratio, kernel-switch count, and per-route p99. Also add an eval job on convo-repro set to catch quality regressions from head changes and from RoPE scaling impacts.
maria: RoPE note: longer sequences re-evaluate positional multiply kernels and that shifts compute vs memory. For seq>1024 we see higher relative kernel time, so kernel pick should be seq-aware as well.
zhang: Agree. We should add seq-length buckets to selector heuristics and to the perf tests.
sasha: TL;DR mitigations: kv_slab_coalesce on, headstride pad to 256 for Mixtral/Mistral with 64-dim heads, qbatch target 4 for latency-critical routes, kernel-selector rule tweak for packed_head_v3. Canary & eval before wider roll.
maria: Sounds good. Who's taking ownership to run the canary + eval?
ben: I'll run the canary and attach the traces. ETA end of day.
alex: Thanks — please drop results in this thread and I'll update the rollout playbook. :thumbsup:
